_comment: Response headers policy for the STATIC behaviours (default * and /_next/static/*) of the ITAM distribution. Same values the Node build sets in next.config.ts. Replace SITE_DOMAIN with the distribution's public domain (the same host that serves /api/*). Do NOT attach this policy to the /api/* behaviour: the API sets its own headers (see README).
Name: itam-static-security-headers

ContentSecurityPolicy.ContentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' wss://SITE_DOMAIN https://SITE_DOMAIN; frame-src https://www.openstreetmap.org; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
